problem.title: B2B buyers have changed how they shortlist vendors.
problem.p1: They're not starting on Google. They're asking ChatGPT and buying from whoever shows up in that answer.
problem.p2: If your competitor is showing up in that answer and you're not, the deal starts without you.
problem.p3: Your AI search presence should catch up to this shift.

items.question: Do I have to book a call?
items.answer: No. You get the full report first. If you want to talk through what it means, there’s an option to book time with Arnel after delivery. No pressure.

items.question: How is this different from a generic SEO audit?
items.answer: It’s not an SEO audit. We’re measuring AI search visibility — whether your brand gets cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity when your buyers search for solutions. Most tools don’t track this at all.

items.question: What do you do with my information?
items.answer: We run your audit and send you the report. That’s it. No spam, no auto-enrollment in a sequence.
